t: A Mini-ITX RISC-V motherboard that fits a normal PC case.
steps: Look for the board at ARACE, Taobao, or JD, and check stock first.
Get a 12 V power supply, a USB-C PD charger, or an ATX power supply.
Download a Bianbu or Ubuntu image from the Milk-V resources page.
Flash the image to a microSD card with a free tool like balenaEtcher.
Connect a monitor, keyboard, mouse, and network cable.
Insert the card and plug in power. The board turns on right away.
Open a terminal and compile a small hello world program in C.
